announcements.title: SEC Publishes Updated Market Statistics, Highlighting Increase in IPOs and Proceeds Raised
announcements.summary: The SEC's Division of Economic and Risk Analysis published updated U.S. capital markets statistics and interactive data visualizations on September 23, 2026. The report highlights year-over-year growth in initial public offerings and follow-on registered offerings for the first half of 2026. The release aims to provide transparent data supporting resilient capital formation and market oversight.
announcements.action: No action required; for awareness only.

announcements.title: SEC Charges South Florida Resident and His Company for Alleged Investment Scheme Defrauding Law Enforcement
announcements.summary: The SEC charged CMI Capital LLC and its founder Michael D. Williams for an alleged fraudulent investment scheme targeting law enforcement officers. The defendants allegedly raised approximately $860,000 and misappropriated $384,000 for personal expenses. They have agreed to a bifurcated settlement subject to court approval, including permanent injunctions and civil penalties.

announcements.title: Building the next generation of market infrastructure
announcements.summary: Nikhil Rathi, FCA chief executive, delivered a speech discussing the evolution of market infrastructure, tokenisation, and AI in the UK financial sector. He highlighted that the FCA and Bank of England will release an upcoming joint tokenisation roadmap to guide the transition from testing to established infrastructure. Additionally, the FCA intends to consult on safeguarding rules for relevant tokenised investment assets following industry feedback.
announcements.business_area: 交易申報與市場基礎設施

frameworks.name: Crypto-asset regime
frameworks.reason: The speech discusses tokenisation, stablecoins, cryptoassets, and the FCA's upcoming consultation on safeguarding rules for relevant tokenised investment assets and digital assets.

announcements.action: Review the upcoming joint tokenisation roadmap with the Bank of England and monitor forthcoming FCA consultations on safeguarding rules for tokenised investment assets.

announcements.title: Firms crack down on money mules but need to do more
announcements.summary: Financial firms closed over 238,000 suspected money mule accounts in 2025, reflecting improved identification and rising criminal activity. Despite these actions, organised criminal groups continue to launder billions through complex multi-account networks before cashing out. The FCA and law enforcement are collaborating on industry action plans to enhance intelligence sharing and early detection.
announcements.action: Review current detection and early-closure protocols for suspected money mule accounts to align with FCA economic crime priorities and intelligence-sharing initiatives.

announcements.title: SEC Censures OTC Link LLC for Repeated Compliance Failures Related to Regulation SCI
announcements.summary: The SEC censured broker-dealer OTC Link LLC and ordered a $575,000 civil penalty for longstanding violations of Regulation SCI. The firm repeatedly failed to establish, maintain, and enforce written policies and procedures regarding system security, access control, and vulnerability management for its alternative trading system. Without admitting the findings, OTC Link agreed to a cease-and-desist order, censure, and the financial penalty.
announcements.action: Review and update written policies and procedures for SCI systems, including security, access control, and vulnerability management, to ensure compliance with Regulation SCI Rule 1001 requirements.

announcements.title: Debt advice warning: spot the red flags
announcements.summary: The FCA warns consumers seeking debt advice to watch out for red flags such as fee-paying solutions pushed through high-pressure sales tactics or by unauthorized firms. Regulators recently took enforcement action against Curtis Faraday and banned a senior manager at Beauforce Corporation Limited. Consumers with debt management plans through Beauforce are urged to stop payments and seek alternative support.
announcements.business_area: 消費者保護與產品行銷
announcements.action: Review consumer debt advice onboarding and sales practices against FCA guidance to ensure appropriate permissions and prevent misleading fee-charging steering.

announcements.title: FCA takes Hunter Jones to High Court over alleged unauthorised activity
announcements.summary: The FCA has initiated High Court proceedings against Hunter Jones Group for allegedly conducting regulated activities without authorization. The regulator is seeking court orders to halt these activities and secure the return of funds to investors. Consumers dealing with this unauthorized firm are warned of heightened financial risks and lack of standard protections.

announcements.title: FCA and partners join forces to help improve financial security for millions
announcements.summary: The FCA is partnering with industry, government, and consumer groups to expand protection insurance coverage for millions of unprotected adults. Initiatives include addressing rule misunderstandings, reducing medical record delays, and hosting a TechSprint. Additionally, the FCA published findings on the protection market, reminding firms of their Consumer Duty and product governance obligations.

announcements.title: Building a stronger UK investment culture
announcements.summary: Lucy Castledine outlined the regulator's vision for a resilient UK investment culture at the 2026 Investor Summit, focusing on growth and innovation, simpler communications, and tackling fraud. She highlighted recent retail investment reforms, including the targeted support regime and consultations on simplifying the advice framework and product disclosures. Additionally, she emphasized the importance of robust consumer protection, addressing risks related to AI usage in financial decisions, and combating unlawful finfluencers and fraudulent advertisements.

announcements.title: Financial crime: protecting the hive
announcements.summary: Steve Smart delivered a speech discussing the importance of collective action and partnership between the FCA, law enforcement, and firms to combat financial crime. He highlighted the FCA's ongoing efforts in intelligence-led supervision, data sharing, and technology integration. Additionally, he addressed preparations for the FCA's upcoming role in taking over AML supervision for the legal and accounting sectors.

announcements.title: SEC Issues “Innovation Exemption” to Facilitate the Trading of Tokenized NMS Stock and Request for Comment
announcements.summary: The SEC issued an order granting temporary, conditional exemptive relief known as the 'Innovation Exemption' to Tokenized Securities Venues to trade tokenized NMS stock. The order also temporarily grants a conditional exemption from the definition of 'dealer' to liquidity providers in associated AMM Liquidity Pools. Furthermore, the Commission is soliciting public comments on all aspects of the exemption and potential next steps.

announcements.title: FCA and partners continues crackdown on illegal crypto trading
announcements.summary: The FCA, alongside HMRC and the Metropolitan Police, targeted three London premises suspected of illegal peer-to-peer crypto trading. Cease and desist letters were issued to the traders to halt unregistered crypto business operations. The enforcement highlights ongoing joint efforts to combat money laundering and illicit fund movements via digital assets.

announcements.title: FCA sets out steps to support small businesses' access to finance
announcements.summary: The FCA published the findings of its review on SME access to finance, concluding that regulation is not a major barrier. It identified key challenges such as limited awareness and complex application processes. The regulator is now focusing on three practical areas to reduce friction and support a more proportionate regulatory framework.

announcements.title: FCA opens investigation into Euro Exchange Securities UK Ltd
announcements.summary: The FCA has opened an investigation into Euro Exchange Securities UK Ltd (EES) regarding potential offences under the Money Laundering Regulations 2017. The inquiry focuses on whether EES failed to properly identify, assess, and document money laundering risks between February 2020 and June 2026. Investigators are also examining potential failures in establishing and maintaining effective policies, controls, and procedures to mitigate those risks.

announcements.title: Better outcomes begin when payment firms understand customers’ needs
announcements.summary: The FCA highlights findings from its consumer vulnerability review for payment and e-money firms, emphasizing the importance of understanding customer needs. It reminds firms that under the Consumer Duty, they must act to deliver good outcomes for retail customers, including those in vulnerable circumstances. Firms are encouraged to review their practical effectiveness using management information and feedback to ensure payment services remain accessible.

announcements.title: SEC Proposes Rescission of Shareholder Proposal Rule and Reforms to Proxy Solicitation Process
announcements.summary: The SEC proposed rescinding Rule 14a-8 regarding shareholder proposals, citing statutory overreach and unintended intrusions into state corporate law. The agency also proposed amendments to Rule 14a-4(c) and modernizing the proxy solicitation process to align with technological advancements. Public comment periods will remain open for 60 days following publication in the Federal Register.

announcements.title: Crypto firms get guidance on how the new regime applies
announcements.summary: The UK Financial Conduct Authority has issued new guidance to help crypto firms understand the application of the upcoming cryptoasset regime and determine authorization requirements. The regulatory framework officially enters into force on October 25, 2027, with authorization applications opening on September 30, 2026. This comprehensive guidance covers various activities including stablecoin issuance, trading platform operations, dealing, safeguarding, and staking services.

announcements.title: Financial regulator bans former law firm owner from financial services

The regulator concluded that Miah lacked the honesty and integrity required for the financial sector. This enforcement action aims to protect consumers and maintain confidence in the financial system.

announcements.title: SEC Grants Exemptive Relief from Certain Inline XBRL Filing or Submission Requirements

The relief applies to specific forms used by market intermediaries, including Form CA-1, Form 1, Form X-17A-5 Part III, Form 17-H, and annual compliance reports for security-based swap entities. This action aims to reduce unnecessary compliance costs for market participants while maintaining investor protection.

announcements.summary: Premier Payment Solutions Ltd, trading as PPS Money, entered liquidation on 10 September 2026 due to significant financial difficulties. Joint liquidators from BTG Begbies Traynor have been appointed to manage the process and assess customer claims for fund distribution. Customers are advised to contact the liquidators directly regarding claims and to remain cautious of third-party firms and potential fraud.

announcements.title: Upper Tribunal upholds Crispin Odey ban
announcements.summary: The Upper Tribunal has upheld the financial services industry ban and a reduced £1.53 million fine against Crispin Odey after finding him to lack integrity. The Tribunal fully upheld all five FCA allegations, noting that he abused his power, bullied executives, and halted internal disciplinary processes regarding his inappropriate behavior. The ruling reinforces regulatory standards on personal accountability, governance, and the enforcement of fitness and propriety within regulated firms.
announcements.business_area: 公司治理與高階人員問責
announcements.action: Review internal governance structures and executive accountability frameworks to ensure senior managers cannot override disciplinary processes or bypass oversight bodies.

announcements.title: Joint Readout of Principals’ Meeting of U.S. and UK Authorities Regarding Central Counterparty Resolution
announcements.summary: Senior officials from U.S. and UK regulatory authorities convened for a tabletop exercise on September 3, 2026, to discuss issues related to the hypothetical resolution of central counterparties. The participants reviewed recent joint work, focusing on information sharing and communications arrangements to support financial stability in a CCP resolution. Authorities acknowledged the ongoing importance of maintaining dialogue, sharing analyses, and discussing policy formulation between UK and U.S. agencies.
announcements.action: No action required; for awareness only.

announcements.title: SEC Charges Founder and His Two New Jersey-Based Companies in Alleged $16 Million Ponzi Scheme
announcements.summary: The SEC charged Ernest Ossei Boateng and two of his companies with orchestrating a $16 million Ponzi scheme targeting vulnerable, inexperienced investors. The defendants allegedly misappropriated millions for personal expenses and speculative trading while falsely promising guaranteed, low-risk returns. The SEC is seeking permanent injunctions, disgorgement, and civil penalties for violations of federal securities antifraud provisions.

announcements.title: Man pleads guilty to fraud and forgery offences relating to fake takeover approach
announcements.summary: Christopher Woolcott has pleaded guilty to four counts of fraud and forgery after fabricating a fake takeover bid for Touchstone Exploration Inc. using false identities and forged documents to artificially influence share prices. The FCA emphasized that combating market abuse and financial crime remains a core priority of its strategy. Woolcott is awaiting sentencing at a later date.

announcements.title: SEC Proposes Rescission of Political Contribution Rule for Investment Advisers
announcements.summary: The SEC issued a proposal to rescind its pay-to-play rule and related recordkeeping requirements for investment advisers. The Commission determined that the 2010 rule has caused significant unintended consequences, operational challenges, and the suppression of political speech. A 60-day public comment period will begin after the release is published in the Federal Register.

The agenda includes discussions on artificial intelligence technologies in public markets and Regulation NMS rules. The meeting will be webcast and aims to advise the Commission on regulatory priorities.

announcements.title: FCA decides to ban and fine Daniel Thomas over unauthorised pension transfer advice

Mr Thomas has referred his Decision Notice to the Upper Tribunal, meaning the findings are currently provisional pending the Tribunal's decision. The investigation revealed he misled clients and pension providers, destroyed records, and failed to cooperate with regulators.

announcements.summary: The SEC announced the agenda and panelists for its upcoming roundtable on preparations for 24-hour trading, scheduled for September 17, 2026. The event will feature discussions covering market readiness, operational resiliency, and expected impacts on liquidity and capital formation. The public can attend in person or watch via a live webcast on the SEC's website.

announcements.title: SEC Proposes to Modernize Rules for Registered Transfer Agents

The MOU will remain in effect for three years, aiming to improve transparency and disclosure compliance across the life sciences sector.

announcements.title: SEC Proposes Amendments to Exchange Act Rule 3a12-8 to Add European Union Debt Obligations

The public comment period will remain open for 60 days following publication in the Federal Register.

announcements.title: SEC: 38 Entities Feigned Legitimacy as U.S. Advisers Through False Filings to Lure Retail Investors
announcements.summary: The SEC charged 38 entities with making material misrepresentations in Forms ADV filed between 2025 and 2026 to falsely portray themselves as legitimate advisory firms. The defendants allegedly used fake addresses, disconnected phone numbers, and fabricated audit claims to lure retail investors. The SEC seeks permanent injunctions, conduct-based prohibitions, and civil penalties against the violators.

announcements.title: Young investors trust AI more than TV or celebrities

The FCA advises investors to exercise caution, verify AI sources, and rely on official tools like InvestSmart to make informed financial decisions.

announcements.title: FCA bans trio behind £35.5m scheme designed to bypass visa rules

Firms are expected to finalize testing plans, monitor UK Accelerated Settlement Taskforce recommendations, and ensure robust client outreach to avoid systemic risks.
